what: The image inside a full-bleed divider photo strip is scaled up to 1 + intensity/400 (1.125x on a 1440 screen), then shifted up and down by (progress from the image entering at the bottom of the screen to leaving at the top, (screen height − image top) ÷ (screen height + image height), minus .5) × intensity px. Intensity is screen width/1440 × 50px, and 1.5x below 768. Tied directly to scroll with no curve, and painted immediately on every scroll event like the original

options.strength: Set the strength in px (if absent, proportional to screen width)
